note: held-unevenly: the catalog delivers value 2010..2025; the steward holds value for 2018..2019 and the register (value and other) for 2017..2021. In holdings scope a dated warning is clipped to the held periods (#1900): value's 'since 2010' (2010..9999-12-31) reads 2018-01-01..2019-12-31, value's 2021 warning lies wholly outside them and is dropped, and the register-wide 2015..2017 warning is clipped to the register's held span, 2017-01-01..2017-12-31. Renamed is delivered as Oldname 2010..2018 and Newname 2019..2025; the steward's 2018 and 2019 tables map it as Newname, so their one column holds 2018's Oldname too. Its Oldname warning (2010..2025) reads 2018-01-01..2018-12-31: the held periods of a spelling are read over each of its states' own bounds, not the warning's window, which also covers Newname's years. Reference scope returns every warning with its stored window. Fails if holdings keeps a warning's reference window (the pre-#1900 reader returned 2010-01-01 and kept the 2021 warning; reading the Oldname cell over the whole warning window found no held period and kept 2010..2025), drops a warning that overlaps the held periods, or clips in reference scope.
